thread:
rachel: quick intake — can we prioritize a bring-up for phoenix-48b? want to validate for RAG and multistep reasoning workloads. model card: https://models.internal/phoenix-48b :point_right: request: perf & quant experiments + basic eval sweep this sprint

sam: +1 to evaluate, curious about memory profile. do we have a target rollout SLA?

rachel: SLA: aim for canary perf in staging by EOD Fri, nothing customer-facing until we pass quality/regression gate. owners: sam (infra), chen (quant), lisa (eval)

chen: planning int8 + nf4 qconfigs. initial plan: 1) int8 static per-layer, 2) nf4 mixed, 3) fallback fp16. need 2 A100s for smoke runs. anyone object?

lisa: I'll assemble eval prompt sets: conv QA, code, summarization, hallucination probes. also add our regression set against baseline-40b.

arjun: can we get a quick prio score? helps roadmap. my initial read: latency upside high, cost moderate, quality risk medium.

rachel: proposed prio rubric (quick): latency: 9/10, infra lift: 7/10, eval risk: 6/10, business impact: 8/10 -> aggregate 7.5/10

sam: fine by me. schedule wise we have capacity Friday afternoon after the optimizer patch. I'll claim infra runs.

lisa: eval checklist (short):
- run eval-bench on conv QA (1000 prompts)
- run coding subset (CodeX style, 200 prompts)
- compare Rouge/BLEU/EM + custom hallucination metric
- run regression diffs vs baseline-40b

chen: quick perf snippet from local smoke (pre-optim):
```
Sequence=512 | FP16 throughput=45 tok/s | int8(fastpath)=62 tok/s | mem_peak_fp16=160GB | mem_peak_int8=95GB
```
numbers are noisy — will rerun in CI.

arjun: devex note: please annotate model-tag `phoenix-48b:v0.1-quant` in the rollout config so routing policies can pick it.

eval-bot: automated note: scheduled eval job #452 for phoenix-48b in 30m. results will post to /evals/phoenix-48b/452.json :robot_face:

sam: infra checklist for bring-up (short):
- allocate staging pool (2xA100) -> done
- env var for KV cache tuning -> sam to push
- enable continuous batching with 8-16ms target
- setup canary route with 1% traffic to phoenix-48b

rachel: gating rules we agreed: fail if any of the following -> regression delta > 2% EM on QA, hallucination score worse by >5pts, p95 latency worse than baseline-40b by >1.5x

chen: plan for quant runs:
- run static int8 with per-layer calibration (calib set = 5k tokens)
- run nf4 mixed (embedding and attention heads preserved fp16)
- measure perplexity shift + eval metrics
- add stress run for kv cache correctness (long context 8k)

lisa: noted. I'll add the regression gates into the eval harness and create a quick dashboard.

arjun: UX/consumers: remind product that this model may increase cost 20-30% per token vs 40b baseline unless nf4 holds.

sam: deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled by infra at 2026-03-12T22:00Z (approx).

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline started -> pipeline/phoenix-48b/canary-1

rachel: thanks everyone. next steps: chen + sam run quant & smoke, lisa runs eval sweep, i'll synthesize a short report and post here with pass/fail and recommended rollout. if anyone hits blockers ping me directly. :thumbsup:

lisa: quick Q — do we want to include a reranker microbenchmark (1k queries) in this sweep? could catch ranking regressions.

rachel: yes add reranker checks.

chen: I'll post raw calibration logs to GCS and tag this thread.

sam: keeping notes: if int8 has correctness drift on long context we'll try head-partial-fp16 fallback.

rachel: end-of-thread plan: sync tomorrow 10am to review eval-bot results and decide canary progression.

arjun: ack, added to calendar.

eval-bot: eval results uploaded: /evals/phoenix-48b/452.json (placeholder until runs complete)

lisa: thanks — will start comparisons as soon as results land.

rachel: closing for now. small follow-up: please add short notes to the onboarding checklist template after this run (what failed/passed) so next model benefits. :seedling:
